+def _quota_intervals(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    def valid(selected):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in selected}
+        if not mandatory <= ids:
+            return False
+        counts = {}
+        for job in selected:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        for group, (low, high) in quotas.items():
+            if not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high:
+                return False
+        active = []
+        for job in sorted(selected, key=lambda item: (item["start"], item["end"])):
+            active = [end for end in active if end > job["start"]]
+            active.append(job["end"])
+            if len(active) > 2:
+                return False
+        return True
+
+    def enumerate_subsets(index, selected):
+        nonlocal best_value, best_ids
+        if len(selected) > k or len(selected) + len(options) - index < k:
+            return
+        if index == len(options):
+            if len(selected) != k or not valid(selected):
+                return
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in selected)
+            ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in selected))
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value
+                    or (value == best_value and ids < best_ids)):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+            return
+        enumerate_subsets(index + 1, selected)
+        enumerate_subsets(index + 1, selected + [options[index]])
+
+    enumerate_subsets(0, [])
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
